Chapter 17

ServicesService

In “Using a Pod’s IP Address for Network Communication” on page 118, we learned that you can communicate with a Pod by its IP address. A restart of a Pod will automatically assign a new virtual ClusterIP address. Therefore, other parts of your system cannot rely on the Pod’s IP address if they need to talk to one another. Building a microservices architecture, where each of the components runs in its own Pod with the need to communicate with each other through a stable network interface, requires a different primitive, the Service.

在第 118 页“Using a Pod’s IP Address for Network Communication”中，我们学到可以通过 Pod 的 IP 地址与它通信。Pod 重启后会自动分配一个新的虚拟 ClusterIP 地址。因此，系统中其他部分如果需要互相通信，就不能依赖 Pod 的 IP 地址。在构建微服务架构时，每个组件都运行在自己的 Pod 中，并且需要通过稳定的网络接口互相通信——这就需要另一种原语：Service。

The Service implements an abstraction layer on top of Pods, assigning a fixed virtual IP fronting all the Pods with matching labels, and that virtual IP is called ClusterIP. This chapter will focus on the ins and outs of Services, and most importantly the exposure of Pods inside and outside of the cluster based on their declared type.

Service 在 Pod 之上实现了一层抽象，为所有匹配 label 的 Pod 分配一个固定的虚拟 IP 作为前端，这个虚拟 IP 称为 ClusterIP。本章将聚焦 Service 的来龙去脉，尤其是根据声明的 type 把 Pod 暴露到集群内外。

Accessing a Service in minikube在 minikube 中访问 Service

Accessing Services of type NodePort and LoadBalancer in minikube requires special handling. Refer to the documentation for detailed instructions.

在 minikube 中访问 NodePort 和 LoadBalancer 类型的 Service 需要特殊处理。详细说明请参考文档。

Coverage of Curriculum Objectives考试大纲覆盖

This chapter addresses the following curriculum objectives:

本章涉及以下考试大纲目标：

  • Understand connectivity between Pods理解 Pod 之间的连通性
  • Use ClusterIP, NodePort, LoadBalancer service types and endpoints使用 ClusterIP、NodePort、LoadBalancer 服务类型与 endpoints
  • Understand and use CoreDNS理解并使用 CoreDNS
— PDF p.243 —

Working with Services使用 Service

In a nutshell, Services provide discoverable names and load balancing to a set of Pods. The Service remains agnostic from IP addresses with the help of the Kubernetes DNS control-plane component, an aspect we’ll discuss in “Discovering the Service by DNS lookup” on page 230. Similar to a Deployment, the Service determines the Pods it works on with the help of label selection.

简而言之，Service 为一组 Pod 提供可发现的名称和负载均衡。借助 Kubernetes 控制平面的 DNS 组件，Service 不再与 IP 地址绑定——这一点我们会在第 230 页“Discovering the Service by DNS lookup”中讨论。与 Deployment 类似，Service 通过 label 选择来确定它作用于哪些 Pod。

Figure 17-1 illustrates the functionality. Pod 1 receives traffic as its assigned label matches with the label selection defined in the Service. Pod 2 does not receive traffic, as it defines a nonmatching label.

图 17-1 展示了这一功能。Pod 1 收到流量，因为它的 label 与 Service 中定义的 label 选择匹配；Pod 2 不接收流量，因为它定义的 label 不匹配。

Note that it is possible to create a Service without a label selector to support other scenarios. Refer to the relevant Kubernetes documentation for more information.

请注意，也可以创建不带 label 选择器的 Service 来支持其他场景。更多信息参见相关 Kubernetes 文档。

Services and DeploymentsService 与 Deployment

Services are a complementary concept to Deployments. Services route network traffic to a set of Pods, and Deployments delegate to a ReplicaSet to manage a set of Pods, the replicas. While you can use both concepts in isolation, it is recommended to use Deployments and Services together. The primary reason is the ability to scale the number of replicas and at the same time be able to expose an endpoint to funnel network traffic to those Pods.

Service 是 Deployment 的补充概念。Service 把网络流量路由到一组 Pod，而 Deployment 委托 ReplicaSet 管理一组 Pod（即副本）。虽然你可以单独使用这两个概念，但建议把 Deployment 和 Service 配合使用。主要原因是：你既能扩缩副本数量，又能同时暴露一个 endpoint 把网络流量引流到这些 Pod。

— PDF p.244 —

Service TypesService 类型

Every Service defines a type. The type is responsible for exposing the Service inside and/or outside of the cluster. Table 17-1 lists the Service types relevant to the exam.

每个 Service 都定义了一个 type。该 type 决定 Service 在集群内和/或集群外暴露。表 17-1 列出了与考试相关的 Service 类型。

TypeDescription
ClusterIPExposes the Service on a cluster-internal IP. Reachable only from within the cluster. Kubernetes uses a round-robin algorithm to distribute traffic evenly among the targeted Pods.
ClusterIP在一个集群内部 IP 上暴露 Service。只能从集群内部访问。Kubernetes 使用轮询算法把流量均匀分发到目标 Pod。
NodePortExposes the Service on each node’s IP address at a static port. Accessible from outside of the cluster. The Service type does not provide any load balancing across multiple nodes.
NodePort在每个节点的 IP 上以静态端口暴露 Service。可从集群外部访问。该 Service 类型不提供跨多节点的负载均衡。
LoadBalancerExposes the Service externally using a cloud provider’s load balancer.
LoadBalancer使用云厂商的负载均衡器把 Service 暴露到外部。

Other Service types, e.g., ExternalName or the headless Service, can be defined; however, we’ll not address them in this book, as they are not within the scope of the exam. For more information, refer to the Kubernetes documentation.

也可以定义其他 Service 类型，例如 ExternalName 或 headless Service；但本书不讨论它们，因为不在考试范围内。更多信息参见 Kubernetes 文档。

Service type inheritanceService 类型的继承

The Service types just mentioned, ClusterIP, NodePort, and LoadBalancer, make a Service accessible with different scopes of exposure. It’s imperative to understand that those Service types also build on top of each other. Figure 17-2 shows the relationship between different Service types.

刚才提到的 ClusterIP、NodePort 和 LoadBalancer 这几种 Service 类型，使 Service 以不同的暴露范围可被访问。必须理解的是：这些 Service 类型也是层层叠加的。图 17-2 展示了不同 Service 类型之间的关系。

For example, creating a Service of type NodePort means that the Service will bear the network accessibility characteristics of a ClusterIP Service type as well. In turn, a NodePort Service is accessible from within and from outside of the cluster. This chapter demonstrates each Service type by example. You will find references to the inherited exposure behavior in the following sections.

例如，创建一个 NodePort 类型的 Service，意味着它同时也具备 ClusterIP 类型的网络可达性特征。也就是说，NodePort Service 既可以从集群内部访问，也可以从集群外部访问。本章会通过示例演示每种 Service 类型。在接下来的小节中，你会看到对这种继承而来的暴露行为的引用。

— PDF p.245 —

When to use which Service type?何时使用哪种 Service 类型？

When building a microservices architecture, the question arises of which Service type to choose to implement certain use cases. We briefly discuss this question here.

在构建微服务架构时，会遇到这样的问题：实现某个用例应该选哪种 Service 类型？我们在这里简要讨论。

The ClusterIP Service type is suitable for use cases that call for exposing a microservice to other Pods within the cluster. Say you have a frontend microservice that needs to connect to one or many backend microservices. To properly implement the scenario, you’d stand up a ClusterIP Service that routes traffic to the backend Pods. The frontend Pods would then talk to that Service.

ClusterIP 类型适合需要把微服务暴露给集群内其他 Pod 的用例。假设你有一个前端微服务，需要连接到一个或多个后端微服务。要正确实现这个场景，你会起一个 ClusterIP Service，把流量路由到后端 Pod，然后前端 Pod 与该 Service 通信。

The NodePort Service type is often mentioned as a way to expose an application to consumers external to the cluster. Consumers will have to know the node’s IP address and the statically assigned port to connect to the Service. That’s problematic for multiple reasons. First, the node port is usually allocated dynamically. Therefore, you won’t typically know it in advance. Second, providing the node’s IP address will funnel the network traffic only through a single node so you will not have load balancing at your disposal. Finally, by opening a publicly available node port, you are at risk of increasing the attack surface of your cluster. For all these reasons, a NodePort Service is primarily used for development or testing purposes, and less so in production environments.

NodePort 类型常被提及为把应用暴露给集群外部消费者的一种方式。消费者必须知道节点 IP 和静态分配的端口才能连接到 Service。这存在多方面问题。首先，节点端口通常是动态分配的，你一般无法提前知道。其次，使用节点 IP 会把网络流量只引流到单个节点，因此你无法获得负载均衡。最后，开放一个公开的节点端口会增加集群的攻击面。由于这些原因，NodePort Service 主要用于开发或测试，较少用于生产环境。

The LoadBalancer Service type makes the application available to outside consumers through an external IP address provided by an external load balancer. Network traffic will be distributed across multiple nodes in the cluster. This solution works great for production environments, but keep in mind that every provisioned load balancer will accrue costs and can lead to an expensive infrastructure bill. A more cost-effective solution is the use of an Ingress, discussed in Chapter 18.

LoadBalancer 类型通过外部负载均衡器提供的外部 IP 地址，让外部消费者可以访问应用。网络流量会被分发到集群中的多个节点。这个方案在生产环境中很好用，但要记住：每供应一个负载均衡器都会产生费用，可能导致高昂的基础设施账单。更省钱的方案是使用 Ingress，见第 18 章。

Port Mapping端口映射

A Service uses label selection to determine the set of Pods to forward traffic to. Successful routing of network traffic depends on the port mapping.

Service 通过 label 选择来确定要把流量转发到哪一组 Pod。网络流量能否成功路由，取决于端口映射。

Figure 17-3 shows a Service that accepts incoming traffic on port 80. That’s the port defined by the attribute spec.ports[].port in the manifest. Any incoming traffic is then routed toward the target port, represented by spec.ports[].targetPort.

图 17-3 展示了一个在 80 端口接收入站流量的 Service。这是清单中 spec.ports[].port 属性定义的端口。所有入站流量随后被路由到目标端口，即 spec.ports[].targetPort 所表示的端口。

— PDF p.246 —

The target port is the same port as defined by the container with spec.containers[].ports[].containerPort running inside the label-selected Pod. In this example, that’s port 8080. The selected Pod(s) will receive traffic only if the Service’s target port and the container port match.

目标端口与 label 选中的 Pod 内容器通过 spec.containers[].ports[].containerPort 定义的端口相同。在本例中就是 8080。只有当 Service 的 targetPort 与容器暴露的端口匹配时，被选中的 Pod 才会收到流量。

Creating Services创建 Service

You can create Services in a variety of ways, some of which are more appropriate for the exam as they provide a fast turnaround. Let’s discuss the imperative approach first.

创建 Service 有多种方式，其中一些更适合考试，因为它们能快速完成。我们先讨论命令式方式。

A Service needs to select a Pod with a matching label. The Pod created by the following run command is called echoserver, which exposes the application on the container port 8080. Internally, it automatically assigns the label key-value pair run=echoserver to the object:

Service 需要选择一个 label 匹配的 Pod。下面的 run 命令创建的 Pod 名为 echoserver，把应用暴露在容器端口 8080 上。在内部，它会自动为该对象分配 label 键值对 run=echoserver：

$ kubectl run echoserver --image=k8s.gcr.io/echoserver:1.10 --restart=Never \
  --port=8080
pod/echoserver created

You can create a Service object using the create service command. Make sure to provide the Service type as a mandatory argument. Here we are using the type clusterip. The command-line option --tcp specifies the port mapping. Port 80 exposes the Service to incoming network traffic. Port 8080 targets the container port exposed by the Pod:

你可以使用 create service 命令创建 Service 对象。务必把 Service 类型作为必填参数提供。这里我们使用 clusterip 类型。命令行选项 --tcp 指定端口映射。端口 80 把 Service 暴露给入站网络流量，端口 8080 指向 Pod 暴露的容器端口：

$ kubectl create service clusterip echoserver --tcp=80:8080
service/echoserver created
— PDF p.247 —

An even faster workflow of creating a Pod and Service together can be achieved with a run command and the --expose option. The following command creates both objects in one swoop while establishing the proper label selection. This command-line option is a good choice during the exam to save time if you are asked to create a Pod and a Service:

用 run 命令加上 --expose 选项，可以实现同时创建 Pod 和 Service 的更快工作流。下面的命令一次性创建这两个对象，同时建立正确的 label 选择。如果考试要求你同时创建 Pod 和 Service，这个命令行选项是节省时间的好选择：

$ kubectl run echoserver --image=k8s.gcr.io/echoserver:1.10 --restart=Never \
  --port=8080 --expose
service/echoserver created
pod/echoserver created

It’s actually more common to use a Deployment and Service that work together. The following set of commands creates a Deployment with five replicas and then uses the expose deployment command to instantiate the Service object. The port mapping can be provided with the options --port and --target-port:

实际中更常见的是把 Deployment 和 Service 配合使用。下面这组命令创建一个有五个副本的 Deployment，然后用 expose deployment 命令实例化 Service 对象。端口映射可以通过 --port 和 --target-port 选项提供：

$ kubectl create deployment echoserver --image=hashicorp/http-echo:1.0.0 \
  --replicas=5
deployment.apps/echoserver created
$ kubectl expose deployment echoserver --port=80 --target-port=8080
service/echoserver exposed

Example 17-1 shows the representation of a Service in the form of a YAML manifest. The Service declares the key-value app=echoserver for label selection and defines the port mapping from 80 to 8080.

例 17-1 以 YAML 清单的形式展示了 Service 的表示。该 Service 声明了键值 app=echoserver 用于 label 选择，并定义了从 80 到 8080 的端口映射。

Example 17-1. A Service defined by a YAML manifest

例 17-1. 由 YAML 清单定义的 Service

apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: echoserver
spec:
  selector:
    run: echoserver
  ports:
  - port: 80
    targetPort: 8080
  • Selects all Pods with the given label assignment.选中所有具有给定 label 的 Pod。
  • Defines incoming and outgoing ports of the Service. The outgoing port needs to match the container port of the selected Pods.定义 Service 的入站和出站端口。出站端口需要与被选中 Pod 的容器端口匹配。

The Service YAML manifest shown does not assign an explicit type. A Service object that does not specify a value for the attribute spec.type will default to ClusterIP upon creation.

上面展示的 Service YAML 清单没有显式指定 type。如果 Service 对象没有为 spec.type 属性指定值，创建时默认为 ClusterIP。

— PDF p.248 —

Listing Services列出 Service

Listing all Services presents a table view that includes the Service type, the ClusterIP address, an optional external IP address, and the incoming port(s). Here, you can see the output for the echoserver Pod we created earlier:

列出所有 Service 时会以表格视图展示，包括 Service 类型、ClusterIP 地址、可选的外部 IP 地址以及入站端口。下面是之前创建的 echoserver Pod 的输出：

$ kubectl get services
NAME         TYPE        CLUSTER-IP      EXTERNAL-IP   PORT(S)   AGE
echoserver   ClusterIP   10.109.241.68   <none>        80/TCP    6s

Kubernetes assigns a ClusterIP address given that the Service type is ClusterIP. An external IP address is not available for this Service type. The Service is accessible on port 80.

由于 Service 类型是 ClusterIP，Kubernetes 会分配一个 ClusterIP 地址。这种 Service 类型没有外部 IP 地址。该 Service 在 80 端口可访问。

Rendering Service Details查看 Service 详情

You may want to drill into the details of a Service for troubleshooting purposes. That might be the case if the incoming traffic to a Service isn’t routed properly to the set of Pods you expect to handle the request.

出于故障排查的目的，你可能需要深入查看 Service 的详情。例如，当到达 Service 的入站流量没有被正确路由到你期望处理请求的那组 Pod 时，就会遇到这种情况。

The describe service command renders valuable information about the configuration of a Service. The configuration relevant to troubleshooting a Service is the value of the fields Selector, IP, Port, TargetPort, and Endpoints. A common source of misconfiguration is incorrect label selection and port assignment. Make sure that the selected labels are actually available in the Pods intended to route traffic to and that the target port of the Service matches the exposed container port of the Pods.

describe service 命令会显示关于 Service 配置的有价值信息。与 Service 故障排查相关的配置是 Selector、IP、Port、TargetPort 和 Endpoints 这些字段的值。一个常见的配置错误来源是 label 选择和端口分配不正确。请确保所选择的 label 在你想把流量路由到的 Pod 中确实存在，并且 Service 的 targetPort 与 Pod 暴露的容器端口匹配。

Take a look at the output of the following describe command. It’s the details for a Service created for five Pods controlled by a Deployment. The Endpoints attribute lists a range of endpoints, one for each of the Pods:

请看下面 describe 命令的输出。它是为一个由 Deployment 控制的五个 Pod 所创建 Service 的详情。Endpoints 属性列出了一系列 endpoint，每个 Pod 对应一个：

$ kubectl describe service echoserver
Name:              echoserver
Namespace:         default
Labels:            app=echoserver
Annotations:       <none>
Selector:          app=echoserver
Type:              ClusterIP
IP Family Policy:  SingleStack
IP Families:       IPv4
IP:                10.109.241.68
IPs:               10.109.241.68
Port:              <unset>  80/TCP
TargetPort:        8080/TCP
Endpoints:         172.17.0.4:8080,172.17.0.5:8080,172.17.0.7:8080 + 2 more...
Session Affinity:  None
Events:            <none>
— PDF p.249 —

An endpoint is a resolvable network endpoint, which serves as the virtual IP address and container port of a Pod. If a Service does not render any endpoints, then you are likely dealing with a misconfiguration. Use the EndpointSlice API to interact with the endpoints.

endpoint 是一个可解析的网络端点，对应 Pod 的虚拟 IP 地址和容器端口。如果一个 Service 没有显示任何 endpoints，那你很可能遇到了配置错误。使用 EndpointSlice API 来与 endpoints 交互。

EndpointSlice is Kubernetes’ scalable service discovery mechanism that maps Services to their backing Pod network endpoints. Instead of storing all endpoints in a single object like the deprecated Endpoints API, EndpointSlice distributes this information across multiple smaller objects, with each slice containing up to 100 endpoints by default. The following command lists the endpoints for the Service named echoserver with the assigned label app=echoserver:

EndpointSlice 是 Kubernetes 可扩展的服务发现机制，把 Service 映射到其背后的 Pod 网络端点。与已弃用的 Endpoints API 把所有 endpoints 存在单个对象中不同，EndpointSlice 把这些信息分散到多个较小的对象中，每个 slice 默认最多包含 100 个 endpoint。下面的命令列出带有 label app=echoserver 的 Service echoserver 的 endpoints：

$ kubectl get endpointslices -l app=echoserver
NAME               ADDRESSTYPE   PORTS   ENDPOINTS
echoserver-js2xj   IPv4          8080    10.244.0.10,10.244.0.11,10.244.0.9...

The details of the endpoints give away the full list of IP addresses and ports combinations:

endpoints 的详情会给出完整的 IP 地址与端口组合列表：

$ kubectl describe endpointslice echoserver-js2xj
Name:         echoserver-js2xj
Namespace:    default
Labels:       app=echoserver
              endpointslice.kubernetes.io/managed-by=endpointslice-controller.k8s.io
              kubernetes.io/service-name=echoserver
Annotations:  endpoints.kubernetes.io/last-change-trigger-time: 2025-10-25T17:35:36Z
AddressType:  IPv4
Ports:
  Name     Port  Protocol
  ----     ----  --------
  <unset>  8080  TCP
Endpoints:
  - Addresses:  10.244.0.10
    Conditions:
      Ready:    true
    Hostname:   <unset>
    TargetRef:  Pod/echoserver-85df578d68-q5r57
    NodeName:   minikube
    Zone:       <unset>
    ...

The ClusterIP Service TypeClusterIP 服务类型

ClusterIP is the default Service type. It exposes the Service on a cluster-internal IP address. That means the Service can be accessed only from a Pod running inside of the cluster and not from outside of the cluster (e.g., if you were to make a call to the Service from your local machine). Figure 17-4 illustrates the accessibility of a Service with type ClusterIP.

ClusterIP 是默认的 Service 类型。它在一个集群内部 IP 地址上暴露 Service。这意味着该 Service 只能从集群内部运行的 Pod 访问，而不能从集群外部访问（例如从你本机调用该 Service）。图 17-4 展示了 ClusterIP 类型 Service 的可达性。

— PDF p.250 —

Creating and Inspecting the Service创建并查看 Service

We will create a Pod and a corresponding Service to demonstrate the runtime behavior of the ClusterIP Service type. The Pod named echoserver exposes the container port 8080 and specifies the label app=echoserver. The Service defines port 5005 for incoming traffic, which is forwarded to outgoing port 8080. The label selection matches the Pod we set up:

我们将创建一个 Pod 和对应的 Service，以演示 ClusterIP 类型的运行时行为。名为 echoserver 的 Pod 暴露容器端口 8080，并指定 label app=echoserver。Service 为入站流量定义了 5005 端口，转发到出站端口 8080。label 选择与我们设置的 Pod 匹配：

$ kubectl run echoserver --image=k8s.gcr.io/echoserver:1.10 --restart=Never \
  --port=8080 -l app=echoserver
pod/echoserver created
$ kubectl create service clusterip echoserver --tcp=5005:8080
service/echoserver created

Inspecting the live object with the command kubectl get service echoserver -o yaml will render the assigned ClusterIP address. Example 17-2 shows an abbreviated version of the Service runtime representation.

用 kubectl get service echoserver -o yaml 查看运行中的对象，会显示分配的 ClusterIP 地址。例 17-2 展示了 Service 运行时表示的简化版本。

Example 17-2. A ClusterIP Service object at runtime

例 17-2. 运行时的 ClusterIP Service 对象

apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: echoserver
spec:
  type: ClusterIP
  clusterIP: 10.96.254.0
  selector:
    app: echoserver
— PDF p.251 —
  ports:
  - port: 5005
    targetPort: 8080
    protocol: TCP
  • The Service type set to ClusterIPService 类型设为 ClusterIP
  • The ClusterIP address assigned to the Service at runtime运行时分配给 Service 的 ClusterIP 地址

The ClusterIP address that makes the Service available in this example is 10.96.254.0. Listing the Service object is an alternative way to render the information we need to make a call to the Service:

本例中让 Service 可用的 ClusterIP 地址是 10.96.254.0。列出 Service 对象是另一种显示我们调用 Service 所需信息的方式：

$ kubectl get service echoserver
NAME         TYPE        CLUSTER-IP    EXTERNAL-IP   PORT(S)    AGE
echoserver   ClusterIP   10.96.254.0   <none>        5005/TCP   8s

Next up, we’ll try to make a call to the Service.

接下来我们尝试调用该 Service。

Accessing the Service访问 Service

You can access the Service using a combination of the ClusterIP address and the incoming port: 10.96.254.0:5005. Making a request from any other machine residing outside of the cluster will fail, as illustrated by the following wget command:

你可以用 ClusterIP 地址加入站端口的组合来访问 Service：10.96.254.0:5005。从集群外的任何其他机器发起请求都会失败，如下面的 wget 命令所示：

$ wget 10.96.254.0:5005 --timeout=5 --tries=1
--2021-11-15 15:45:36--  http://10.96.254.0:5005/
Connecting to 10.96.254.0:5005... failed: Operation timed out.
Giving up.

Accessing the Service from a Pod from within the cluster properly routes the request to the Pod matching the label selection:

从集群内部的 Pod 访问 Service，请求会被正确路由到 label 选择匹配的 Pod：

$ kubectl run tmp --image=busybox:1.36.1 --restart=Never -it --rm \
  -- wget 10.96.254.0:5005
Connecting to 10.96.254.0:5005 (10.96.254.0:5005)
saving to 'index.html'
index.html           100% |********************************|   408  0:00:00 ETA
'index.html' saved
pod "tmp" deleted

Apart from using the ClusterIP address and the port, you can also discover a Service by DNS name and environment variables available to containers.

除了使用 ClusterIP 地址和端口，你还可以通过 DNS 名称以及容器可用的环境变量来发现 Service。

Discovering the Service by DNS lookup通过 DNS 查找发现 Service

Kubernetes registers every Service by its name with the help of its DNS service named CoreDNS. Internally, CoreDNS will store the Service name as a hostname and maps it to the ClusterIP address. Accessing a Service by its DNS name instead of an IP address is much more convenient and expressive when building microservice architectures because IP addresses are ephemeral and unpredictable, whereas the labels are declarative and known.

Kubernetes 借助名为 CoreDNS 的 DNS 服务，按名称注册每个 Service。在内部，CoreDNS 会把 Service 名称存储为主机名，并把它映射到 ClusterIP 地址。在构建微服务架构时，用 DNS 名称而不是 IP 地址访问 Service 要方便和清晰得多，因为 IP 地址是临时且不可预测的，而 label 是声明式的、已知的。

— PDF p.252 —

You can verify the correct service discovery by running a Pod in the same namespace that makes a call to the Service by using its hostname and incoming port:

你可以在同一个 namespace 中运行一个 Pod，用主机名和入站端口调用 Service，以此验证服务发现是否正确：

$ kubectl run tmp --image=busybox:1.36.1 --restart=Never -it --rm \
  -- wget echoserver:5005
Connecting to echoserver:5005 (10.96.254.0:5005)
saving to 'index.html'
index.html           100% |********************************|   408  0:00:00 ETA
'index.html' saved
pod "tmp" deleted

It’s not uncommon to make a call from a Pod to a Service that lives in a different namespace. Referencing just the hostname of the Service does not work across namespaces. You need to append the namespace as well. The following makes a call from a Pod in the other namespace to the Service in the default namespace:

从一个 Pod 调用位于另一个 namespace 的 Service 并不少见。仅引用 Service 的主机名在跨 namespace 时行不通，你还需要追加 namespace。下面的命令从 other namespace 中的 Pod 调用 default namespace 中的 Service：

$ kubectl run tmp --image=busybox:1.36.1 --restart=Never -it --rm \
  -n other -- wget echoserver.default:5005
Connecting to echoserver.default:5005 (10.96.254.0:5005)
saving to 'index.html'
index.html           100% |********************************|   408  0:00:00 ETA
'index.html' saved
pod "tmp" deleted

The full hostname for a Service is echoserver.default.svc.cluster.local. The string svc describes the type of resource we are communicating with. CoreDNS uses the default value cluster.local as a domain name (which is configurable if you want to change it). You do not have to spell out the full hostname when communicating with a Service.

Service 的完整主机名是 echoserver.default.svc.cluster.local。字符串 svc 描述了我们正在与之通信的资源类型。CoreDNS 默认使用 cluster.local 作为域名（如果你想改，是可配置的）。与 Service 通信时，你不必拼出完整主机名。

Discovering the Service by environment variables通过环境变量发现 Service

You may find it easier to use the Service connection information directly from the application running in a Pod. The kubelet makes the ClusterIP address and port for every active Service available as environment variables. The naming convention for Service-related environment variables are <SERVICE_NAME>_SERVICE_HOST and <SERVICE_NAME>_SERVICE_PORT.

你可能会发现，直接从 Pod 中运行的应用里使用 Service 连接信息更方便。kubelet 会把每个活跃 Service 的 ClusterIP 地址和端口作为环境变量提供出来。与 Service 相关的环境变量命名约定是 <SERVICE_NAME>_SERVICE_HOST 和 <SERVICE_NAME>_SERVICE_PORT。

Availability of Service environment variablesService 环境变量的可用性

Make sure you create the Service before instantiating the Pod. Otherwise, those environment variables won’t be populated. This is why most developers avoid relying on these environment variables, as they rely on the creation (or deletion) order of objects.

请务必先创建 Service，再实例化 Pod。否则这些环境变量不会被填充。这就是为什么大多数开发者避免依赖这些环境变量——因为它们依赖于对象的创建（或删除）顺序。

— PDF p.253 —

You can check on the actual key-value pairs by listing the environment variables of the container, as follows:

你可以像下面这样列出容器的环境变量，来查看实际的键值对：

$ kubectl exec -it echoserver -- env
ECHOSERVER_SERVICE_HOST=10.96.254.0
ECHOSERVER_SERVICE_PORT=8080
...

The name of the Service, echoserver, does not include any special characters. That’s why the conversion to the environment variable key is easy; the Service name was simply uppercase to conform to environment variable naming conventions. Any special characters (such as dashes) in the Service name will be replaced by underscore characters. You need to make sure that the Service has been created before starting a Pod if you want those environment variables populated.

Service 的名称 echoserver 不包含任何特殊字符，因此转换成环境变量键很容易：Service 名称只是被转成大写，以符合环境变量的命名约定。Service 名称中的任何特殊字符（例如连字符）都会被替换为下划线字符。如果你希望这些环境变量被填充，就必须确保在启动 Pod 之前已经创建了 Service。

The NodePort Service TypeNodePort 服务类型

Declaring a Service with type NodePort exposes access through the node’s IP address and can be resolved from outside of the Kubernetes cluster. The node’s IP address can be reached in combination with a port number in the range of 30000 and 32767 (also called the node port), assigned automatically upon the creation of the Service. Figure 17-5 illustrates the routing of traffic to Pods via a NodePort-type Service.

声明一个 NodePort 类型的 Service 会通过节点 IP 地址暴露访问，并且可以从 Kubernetes 集群外部解析。节点 IP 地址可以配合一个 30000 到 32767 之间的端口号（也称为 node port）来访问，该端口在创建 Service 时自动分配。图 17-5 展示了通过 NodePort 类型 Service 把流量路由到 Pod 的过程。

The node port is opened on every node in the cluster, and its value is global and unique at the cluster-scope level. To avoid port conflicts, it’s best to not define the exact node port and to let Kubernetes find an available port.

node port 会在集群中的每个节点上开放，其值在集群范围内全局唯一。为避免端口冲突，最好不要指定具体的 node port，而是让 Kubernetes 找一个可用端口。

— PDF p.254 —

Creating and Inspecting the Service创建并查看 Service

The next two commands create a Pod and a Service of type NodePort. The only difference here is that nodeport is provided instead of clusterip as a command-line option:

下面两条命令创建一个 Pod 和一个 NodePort 类型的 Service。这里唯一的区别是命令行选项提供的是 nodeport 而不是 clusterip：

$ kubectl run echoserver --image=k8s.gcr.io/echoserver:1.10 --restart=Never \
  --port=8080 -l app=echoserver
pod/echoserver created
$ kubectl create service nodeport echoserver --tcp=5005:8080
service/echoserver created

The runtime representation of the Service object is shown in Example 17-3. It’s important to point out that the node port will be assigned automatically. Keep in mind NodePort (capital N) is the Service type, whereas nodePort (lowercase n) is the key for the value.

Service 对象的运行时表示如例 17-3 所示。需要指出的是，node port 会自动分配。请记住：NodePort（大写 N）是 Service 类型，而 nodePort（小写 n）是值的键。

Example 17-3. A NodePort Service object at runtime

例 17-3. 运行时的 NodePort Service 对象

apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: echoserver
spec:
  type: NodePort
  clusterIP: 10.96.254.0
  selector:
    app: echoserver
  ports:
  - port: 5005
    nodePort: 30158
    targetPort: 8080
    protocol: TCP
  • The Service type set to NodePortService 类型设为 NodePort
  • The statically-assigned node port that makes the Service accessible from outside of the cluster静态分配的 node port，使 Service 可从集群外部访问

Once the Service is created, you can list it. You will find that the port representation contains the statically assigned port that makes the Service accessible:

Service 创建后，你可以列出它。你会发现端口表示中包含了让 Service 可访问的静态分配端口：

$ kubectl get service echoserver
NAME         TYPE        CLUSTER-IP       EXTERNAL-IP   PORT(S)          AGE
echoserver   NodePort    10.101.184.152   <none>        5005:30158/TCP   5s

In this output, the node port is 30158 (identifiable by the separating colon). The incoming port 5005 is still available for the purpose of resolving the Service from within the cluster.

在这个输出中，node port 是 30158（可以通过冒号分隔识别）。入站端口 5005 仍然可用于从集群内部解析该 Service。

— PDF p.255 —

Accessing the Service访问 Service

From within the cluster, you can still access the Service using the ClusterIP address and port number. This Service displays exactly the same behavior as if it were of type ClusterIP:

从集群内部，你仍然可以用 ClusterIP 地址和端口号访问该 Service。这个 Service 表现出与 ClusterIP 类型完全相同的行为：

$ kubectl run tmp --image=busybox:1.36.1 --restart=Never -it --rm \
  -- wget 10.101.184.152:5005
Connecting to 10.101.184.152:5005 (10.101.184.152:5005)
saving to 'index.html'
index.html           100% |********************************|   414  0:00:00 ETA
'index.html' saved
pod "tmp" deleted

From outside of the cluster, you need to use the IP address of any worker node in the cluster and the statically assigned port. One way to determine the worker node’s IP address is by rendering the node details. Another option is to use the status.hostIP attribute value of a Pod, which is the IP address of the worker node the Pod runs on. The node IP address here is 192.168.64.15. It can be used to call the Service from outside of the cluster:

从集群外部，你需要使用集群中任意工作节点的 IP 地址和静态分配的端口。确定工作节点 IP 的一种方法是查看节点详情。另一种方法是使用 Pod 的 status.hostIP 属性值，它就是 Pod 所运行在的工作节点的 IP 地址。这里的节点 IP 地址是 192.168.64.15。可以用它从集群外部调用 Service：

$ kubectl get nodes -o \
  jsonpath='{ $.items[*].status.addresses[?(@.type=="InternalIP")].address }'
192.168.64.15
$ wget 192.168.64.15:30158
--2021-11-16 14:10:16--  http://192.168.64.15:30158/
Connecting to 192.168.64.15:30158... connected.
HTTP request sent, awaiting response... 200 OK
Length: unspecified [text/plain]
Saving to: 'index.html'
...

The LoadBalancer Service TypeLoadBalancer 服务类型

The last Service type to discuss in this book is the LoadBalancer. This Service type provisions an external load balancer, primarily available to Kubernetes cloud providers, which exposes a single IP address to distribute incoming requests to the cluster nodes. The implementation of the load balancing strategy (e.g., round-robin) is up to the cloud provider.

本书要讨论的最后一种 Service 类型是 LoadBalancer。这种 Service 类型会供应一个外部负载均衡器（主要由 Kubernetes 云厂商提供），它暴露一个单一 IP 地址，把入站请求分发到集群节点。负载均衡策略（例如轮询）的实现由云厂商决定。

Load balancers for on-premises Kubernetes clusters本地部署 Kubernetes 集群的负载均衡器

Kubernetes does not offer a native load balancer solution for on-premises clusters. Cloud providers are in charge of providing an appropriate implementation. The MetalLB project aims to fill the gap.

Kubernetes 没有为本地部署集群提供原生的负载均衡方案。云厂商负责提供合适的实现。MetalLB 项目旨在填补这一空白。

— PDF p.256 —

Figure 17-6 shows an architectural overview of the LoadBalancer Service type.

图 17-6 展示了 LoadBalancer Service 类型的架构概览。

As you can see from the illustration, the load balancer routes traffic between different nodes, as long as the targeted Pods fulfill the requested label selection.

如插图所示，只要目标 Pod 满足所请求的 label 选择，负载均衡器就会在不同节点之间路由流量。

Creating and Inspecting the Service创建并查看 Service

To create a Service as a load balancer, set the type to LoadBalancer in the manifest or by using the create service loadbalancer command:

要把 Service 创建为负载均衡器，在清单中把 type 设为 LoadBalancer，或使用 create service loadbalancer 命令：

$ kubectl run echoserver --image=k8s.gcr.io/echoserver:1.10 --restart=Never \
  --port=8080 -l app=echoserver
pod/echoserver created
$ kubectl create service loadbalancer echoserver --tcp=5005:8080
service/echoserver created

The runtime characteristics of a LoadBalancer Service type look similar to the ones provided by the NodePort Service type. The main difference is that the external IP address column has a value, as shown in Example 17-4.

LoadBalancer 类型的运行时特征与 NodePort 类型相似。主要区别在于外部 IP 地址列有了值，如例 17-4 所示。

— PDF p.257 —

Example 17-4. A LoadBalancer Service object at runtime

例 17-4. 运行时的 LoadBalancer Service 对象

apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: echoserver
spec:
  type: LoadBalancer
  clusterIP: 10.96.254.0
  loadBalancerIP: 10.109.76.157
  selector:
    app: echoserver
  ports:
  - port: 5005
    targetPort: 8080
    nodePort: 30158
    protocol: TCP
  • The Service type set to LoadBalancerService 类型设为 LoadBalancer
  • The external IP address assigned to the Service at runtime运行时分配给 Service 的外部 IP 地址

Listing the Service renders the external IP address, which is 10.109.76.157, as demonstrated by this command:

列出 Service 会显示外部 IP 地址，本例中是 10.109.76.157，如下面命令所示：

$ kubectl get service echoserver
NAME         TYPE           CLUSTER-IP      EXTERNAL-IP     PORT(S)          AGE
echoserver   LoadBalancer   10.109.76.157   10.109.76.157   5005:30642/TCP   5s

Given that the external load balancer needs to be provisioned by the cloud provider, it may take a little time until the external IP address becomes available.

由于外部负载均衡器需要由云厂商供应，外部 IP 地址可能需要一点时间才会变为可用。

Accessing the Service访问 Service

To call the Service from outside of the cluster, use the external IP address and its incoming port:

要从集群外部调用 Service，使用外部 IP 地址及其入站端口：

$ wget 10.109.76.157:5005
--2021-11-17 11:30:44--  http://10.109.76.157:5005/
Connecting to 10.109.76.157:5005... connected.
HTTP request sent, awaiting response... 200 OK
Length: unspecified [text/plain]
Saving to: 'index.html'
...

As discussed, a LoadBalancer Service is also accessible in the same way as you would access a ClusterIP or NodePort Service.

如前所述，LoadBalancer Service 也可以像访问 ClusterIP 或 NodePort Service 一样被访问。

— PDF p.258 —

Summary本章小结

Kubernetes assigns a unique IP address for every Pod in the cluster. Pods can communicate with each other using that IP address; however, you cannot rely on the IP address to be stable over time. That’s why Kubernetes provides the Service resource type.

Kubernetes 为集群中的每个 Pod 分配一个唯一 IP 地址。Pod 之间可以用该 IP 地址通信；但你不能指望这个 IP 地址长期稳定。这就是 Kubernetes 提供 Service 资源类型的原因。

A Service forwards network traffic to a set of Pods based on label selection and port mappings. Every Service needs to assign a type that determines how the Service becomes accessible from within or outside of the cluster. The Service types relevant to the exam are ClusterIP, NodePort, and LoadBalancer. CoreDNS, the DNS server for Kubernetes, allows Pods to access the Service by hostname from the same and other namespaces.

Service 基于 label 选择和端口映射，把网络流量转发到一组 Pod。每个 Service 都需要指定一个 type，决定 Service 如何从集群内部或外部被访问。与考试相关的 Service 类型是 ClusterIP、NodePort 和 LoadBalancer。CoreDNS 是 Kubernetes 的 DNS 服务器，它允许 Pod 从同一 namespace 或其他 namespace 通过主机名访问 Service。

Exam Essentials考试要点

Understand the purpose of a Service理解 Service 的用途

Pod-to-Pod communication via their IP addresses doesn’t guarantee a stable network interface over time. A restart of the Pod will lease a new virtual IP address. The purpose of a Service is to provide that stable network interface so that you can operate complex microservice architecture that runs in a Kubernetes cluster. In most cases, Pods call a Service by hostname. The hostname is provided by the DNS server named CoreDNS running as a Pod in the kube-system namespace.

Pod 之间通过 IP 地址通信，并不能保证网络接口长期稳定。Pod 重启后会租用一个新的虚拟 IP 地址。Service 的用途就是提供那个稳定的网络接口，让你能运行在 Kubernetes 集群中的复杂微服务架构。大多数情况下，Pod 通过主机名调用 Service。该主机名由名为 CoreDNS 的 DNS 服务器提供，它以 Pod 形式运行在 kube-system namespace 中。

Practice how to access a Service for each type练习如何访问每种类型的 Service

The exam expects you to understand the differences between the Service types ClusterIP, NodePort, and LoadBalancer. Depending on the assigned type, a Service becomes accessible from inside the cluster or from outside the cluster.

考试要求你理解 ClusterIP、NodePort 和 LoadBalancer 这几种 Service 类型之间的区别。根据所分配的 type，Service 可以从集群内部或集群外部被访问。

Work through Service troubleshooting scenarios演练 Service 故障排查场景

It’s easy to get the configuration of a Service wrong. Any misconfiguration won’t allow network traffic to reach the set of Pods it was intended for. Common misconfigurations include incorrect label selection and port assignments. The kubectl get endpoints command will give you an idea of which Pods a Service can route traffic to.

Service 的配置很容易出错。任何配置错误都会使网络流量无法到达预期的那组 Pod。常见的配置错误包括 label 选择不正确和端口分配不正确。kubectl get endpoints 命令会让你了解一个 Service 能把流量路由到哪些 Pod。

Sample Exercises样题练习

Solutions to these exercises are available in Appendix A.

这些练习的解答见附录 A。

  1. You need to expose a web application that runs on port 80 and has a metrics endpoint on port 9090. The application should be accessible from outside the cluster.你需要暴露一个 Web 应用，它运行在 80 端口，并在 9090 端口上有一个 metrics endpoint。该应用应能从集群外部访问。
— PDF p.259 —
  1. Create a Deployment named webapp using the image nginxdemos/hello:0.4-plain-text with three replicas. Create a Service named webapp-service of type NodePort that exposes port 80 as port 80 (name it web), and exposes port 9090 as port 9090 (name it metrics). Set the node port for the web port to 30080. Use appropriate selectors to target your Deployment. Verify the Service is working by accessing it through the ClusterIP.使用镜像 nginxdemos/hello:0.4-plain-text 创建一个名为 webapp 的 Deployment，三个副本。创建一个名为 webapp-service 的 NodePort 类型 Service，把 80 端口暴露为 80（命名为 web），把 9090 端口暴露为 9090（命名为 metrics）。把 web 端口的 node port 设为 30080。使用合适的 selector 指向你的 Deployment。通过 ClusterIP 访问该 Service，验证它正常工作。
  2. You have a backend database and a frontend application. The frontend needs to connect to the database using service discovery. Both should only be accessible within the cluster. Create a Deployment named database with one replica using image mysql:9.4.0 with these environment variables: MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD=secretpass and MYSQL_DATABASE=myapp. Create a ClusterIP Service named database-service that exposes port 3306 and targets the database Pods. Create a Deployment named frontend with two replicas using image busybox:1.35 that runs a command to continuously test the database connection using the following command: sh -c "while true; do nc -zv database-service 3306; sleep 5; done". Verify that the frontend Pods can resolve and connect to the database Service.你有一个后端数据库和一个前端应用。前端需要通过服务发现连接到数据库。两者都应只能在集群内部访问。使用镜像 mysql:9.4.0 创建一个名为 database 的 Deployment，一个副本，并设置以下环境变量：MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD=secretpass 和 MYSQL_DATABASE=myapp。创建一个名为 database-service 的 ClusterIP Service，暴露 3306 端口并指向数据库 Pod。使用镜像 busybox:1.35 创建一个名为 frontend 的 Deployment，两个副本，运行命令持续测试数据库连接：sh -c "while true; do nc -zv database-service 3306; sleep 5; done"。验证前端 Pod 能够解析并连接到数据库 Service。
— PDF p.260 —
